name: f8a-s613
prompt: <image1> shows a creature. Draw the same creature at its next, more grown-up stage. The whole silhouette changes: it becomes a majestic lagoon dragon flying in the air: the long body curls into one round loop like a ring, the two pairs of wings spread up and back, the gill fronds have grown into a soft coral crown; the silhouette is compact, about as wide as tall, and the head is big enough that the face stays clear. Keep the face, the coral cheeks, the three soft coral gill fronds on each side of the head, the cream belly stripe from chin to tail tip and the flat style without outlines; the body is light warm apricot (#FFC56E), not orange. Fins and wings are coral, never turquoise or green. No teeth, no claws. Full body, plain flat pale mint background.
